description:
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating an artifact creature copy of Magda.
Put the original Magda in the graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping Clock of Omens and Magda, targeting Magda.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Clock of Omens ability, untapping Magda.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping a Treasure token and Magda, targeting Magda.
Repeat from step 4 any number of times.
Activate Magda's last ability any number of times by sacrificing any number of Treasures.
